-- ============================================================
-- test-17-stdlib_pos.fh  –  Standardbibliothek PASS-Tests
--   (STR, MTH, BIG, JSN, IO, ARG)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Stdlib.Pos

import Test.Support exposing Point, make_point

-- STR-01: String.replace
function strip_dashes(sku: String) returns String
requires String.instr(sku, "SKU") >= 0
ensures String.instr(result, "SKU") >= 0
is
    return String.replace(sku, "-", "")
end strip_dashes

-- STR-01 EDGE: Ersetzen mit leerem Ziel
function remove_spaces(s: String) returns String
is
    return String.replace(s, " ", "")
end remove_spaces

-- STR-02: String.instr
function contains_sku(s: String) returns Boolean
is
    return String.instr(s, "SKU") >= 0
end contains_sku

-- STR-05 EDGE: leeres Pattern (immer 0)
function instr_empty(s: String) returns Integer
is
    return String.instr(s, "")
end instr_empty

-- STR-03: String.template mit benannten Argumenten
function format_item(sku: String, zone: String) returns String
requires String.instr(sku, "SKU") >= 0
ensures String.instr(result, "SKU") >= 0
is
    let cleaned: String = String.replace(sku, "-", "")
    return String.template("${sku}@${zone}", sku: cleaned, zone: zone)
end format_item

-- STR-03: Template mit drei Platzhaltern
function format_triple(a: String, b: String, c: String) returns String
is
    return String.template("${x}-${y}-${z}", x: a, y: b, z: c)
end format_triple

-- MTH-01: Math.max
function higher(a: Double, b: Double) returns Double
ensures result >= a, result >= b
is
    return Math.max(a, b)
end higher

-- MTH-02: Math.floor
function floor_val(d: Double) returns Integer
is
    return Math.floor(Math.max(d, 0.0))
end floor_val

-- MTH-02 EDGE: negativer Double
function floor_negative() returns Integer
is
    return Math.floor(-2.9)
end floor_negative

-- BIG-01: Big.fromInteger
function to_big(n: Integer) returns BigInteger
requires n >= 0
is
    return Big.fromInteger(n)
end to_big

-- BIG-01 EDGE: maximaler Wert
function big_max_int() returns BigInteger
is
    return Big.fromInteger(2147483647)
end big_max_int

-- BIG-02: Big.addInt
function big_sum(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns BigInteger
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
is
    let ba: BigInteger = Big.fromInteger(a)
    let bb: BigInteger = Big.fromInteger(b)
    return Big.addInt(ba, bb)
end big_sum

-- BIG-03: Big.toString
function big_text(n: Integer) returns String
requires n >= 0
is
    let big_n: BigInteger = Big.fromInteger(n)
    return Big.toString(big_n)
end big_text

-- JSN-01: Json.stringify auf Record
function point_json(p: Point) returns String
is
    return Json.stringify(p)
end point_json

-- JSN-02 EDGE: stringify auf primitiven Typ
function int_json(n: Integer) returns String
requires n >= 0
is
    let p: Point = Point { x: n, y: n }
    return Json.stringify(p)
end int_json

-- IO-01: logf mit einem Platzhalter
procedure log_integer(n: Integer)
is
    call Std.IO.logf("n = ${}", n)
end log_integer

-- IO-02: logf mit mehreren Platzhaltern
procedure log_two(a: Integer, b: String)
is
    call Std.IO.logf("a=${}, b=${}", a, b)
end log_two

-- IO-01: logf ohne Platzhalter
procedure log_static()
is
    call Std.IO.logf("Programm gestartet")
end log_static

-- ARG-01: Positionale Argumente
function pos_args(a: Integer, b: Integer, c: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0, b >= 0, c >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return a + b + c
end pos_args

-- ARG-02/03: Benannte Argumente
function named_tmpl(name: String, count: Integer) returns String
requires String.instr(name, "") = 0, count >= 0
is
    return String.template("${n} hat ${c} Eintraege", n: name, c: count)
end named_tmpl

end Test.Stdlib.Pos
